name: inclusive_vat_single_rate
description: LAUNCH-P4 C1: menu prices INCLUDE VAT (pricesIncludeTax). Lines 1.050 x1 + 0.800 x2 = gross G 2.650. One 5% VAT: R = 5, tax = round(G x r / (100 + R)) = round(2650 x 5 / 105) = round(126.190...) = 126. The grand total IS the gross: 2.650 (nothing is added on top). Identity for inclusive orders: raw - discount - comp = grand; the 126 baisas of VAT sit inside it (net of VAT 2.524).
